whatIsForexTrading.title: What Is Forex Trading? | WINPROFX Learn
whatIsForexTrading.description: Learn what forex trading is, how currency pairs work, and key risks beginners should understand before trading.

definition.title: Definition
definition.body: Forex (foreign exchange) trading is the buying and selling of currency pairs in the global currency market. Traders speculate on whether one currency will strengthen or weaken against another.

howCurrencyPairsWork.title: How Currency Pairs Work
howCurrencyPairsWork.body: Currency pairs show the value of one currency relative to another (e.g., EUR/USD). The first currency is the base; the second is the quote. Price movements reflect economic conditions, interest rates, and market sentiment.

forexAtWinprofx.body: WINPROFX provides access to forex markets through the MetaTrader 5 platform. Account conditions and available instruments are published on the official website.

whatIsCfdTrading.title: What Is CFD Trading? | WINPROFX Learn
whatIsCfdTrading.description: Understand Contract for Difference (CFD) trading, how it differs from owning assets, and associated risks.

definition.title: Definition
definition.body: A Contract for Difference (CFD) is a derivative that allows traders to speculate on price movements without owning the underlying asset. Profits or losses depend on the difference between entry and exit prices.

cfdsVsOwnership.title: CFDs vs Ownership
cfdsVsOwnership.body: CFD traders do not own shares, commodities, or crypto assets directly. They trade price exposure, which may involve leverage and overnight financing costs depending on account terms.

risks.title: Risks
risks.body: CFD trading carries significant risk. Leverage can amplify losses beyond your initial deposit. Most retail CFD traders lose money.

whatIsLeverageInForex.title: What Is Leverage in Forex? | WINPROFX Learn
whatIsLeverageInForex.description: Understand leverage in forex trading, how it amplifies exposure, and why it increases both potential gains and losses.

definition.title: Definition
definition.body: Leverage allows traders to control a larger position with a smaller amount of capital. It is expressed as a ratio (e.g., 1:100), meaning a small deposit (margin) controls a larger trade size.

howLeverageAffectsRisk.title: How Leverage Affects Risk
howLeverageAffectsRisk.body: Leverage amplifies both potential gains and losses. A small adverse price move can result in significant losses relative to your deposited margin.

whatIsMarginCall.title: What Is a Margin Call? | WINPROFX Learn
whatIsMarginCall.description: Learn what a margin call is, when it occurs, and how margin requirements affect CFD and forex trading.

definition.title: Definition
definition.body: A margin call occurs when your account equity falls below the required margin level to maintain open positions. The broker may request additional funds or close positions to restore margin requirements.

prevention.title: Prevention
prevention.body: Monitor account equity, use appropriate position sizes, understand leverage effects, and maintain adequate free margin. Risk management tools such as stop losses may help but do not eliminate risk.

whatIsSpreadInTrading.title: What Is Spread in Trading? | WINPROFX Learn
whatIsSpreadInTrading.description: Understand bid-ask spread, how spreads affect trading costs, and why spreads vary across instruments.

definition.title: Definition
definition.body: The spread is the difference between the bid (sell) price and ask (buy) price of an instrument. It represents a primary trading cost alongside commissions and swaps where applicable.

variableSpreads.title: Variable Spreads
variableSpreads.body: Spreads may widen during low liquidity, news events, or market volatility. Published spread examples are indicative and may differ at execution.

howToManageRiskInCfdTrading.title: How to Manage Risk in CFD Trading | WINPROFX Learn
howToManageRiskInCfdTrading.description: Educational guide to risk management concepts in CFD trading including position sizing, stop losses, and leverage awareness.
howToManageRiskInCfdTrading.h1: How to Manage Risk in CFD Trading

positionSizing.title: Position Sizing
positionSizing.body: Risk only capital you can afford to lose. Position size should reflect your account balance and tolerance for loss, not maximum available leverage.

stopLossAndTakeProfit.title: Stop Loss and Take Profit
stopLossAndTakeProfit.body: Stop loss orders can limit potential loss on a trade but may not always execute at the exact price during gaps or fast markets. Take profit orders lock in gains at a target level.

diversificationAndDiscipline.title: Diversification and Discipline
diversificationAndDiscipline.body: Avoid over-concentration in a single instrument. Maintain a trading plan and avoid emotional decisions. This content is educational only and not investment advice.

demoVsLiveTradingAccount.title: Demo vs Live Trading Account | WINPROFX Learn
demoVsLiveTradingAccount.description: Compare demo and live trading accounts, their purposes, and what changes when trading with real funds.

demoAccounts.title: Demo Accounts
demoAccounts.body: Demo accounts use virtual funds to practice platform navigation, order placement, and strategy testing without financial risk. Demo conditions may differ from live execution.

liveAccounts.title: Live Accounts
liveAccounts.body: Live accounts use real funds. Losses are real and may exceed deposits when using leverage. KYC verification and compliance checks apply before live trading.

howToCheckIfAForexBrokerIsLegit.title: How to Check If a Forex Broker Is Legit | WINPROFX Learn
howToCheckIfAForexBrokerIsLegit.description: Learn how to verify a forex broker using official domains, company registration, regulatory scope, and risk disclosures.
howToCheckIfAForexBrokerIsLegit.h1: How to Check If a Forex Broker Is Legit
howToCheckIfAForexBrokerIsLegit.breadcrumb: Check If a Broker Is Legit

verifyOfficialDomains.title: Verify Official Domains
verifyOfficialDomains.body: Confirm the website URL matches the broker's published official domains. Avoid login pages reached through unsolicited links or social media messages.

reviewCompanyRegistration.title: Review Company Registration
reviewCompanyRegistration.body: Check whether the legal entity is disclosed with incorporation details and downloadable documents where available. Company registration is not the same as a financial services license.

understandRegulatoryScope.title: Understand Regulatory Scope
understandRegulatoryScope.body: Determine what licenses or registrations exist and what they actually authorize. A representative office license differs from a financial broker license.

offshoreVsRegulatedForexBrokers.title: Offshore vs Regulated Forex Brokers | WINPROFX Learn
offshoreVsRegulatedForexBrokers.description: Understand differences between offshore incorporation and financial services regulation in forex brokerage.

offshoreIncorporation.title: Offshore Incorporation
offshoreIncorporation.body: Many brokers are incorporated in jurisdictions such as Saint Lucia as International Business Companies. Incorporation confirms legal entity formation but does not automatically mean financial services regulation.

financialServicesRegulation.title: Financial Services Regulation
financialServicesRegulation.body: Financial services regulators (such as FCA, ASIC, CySEC, or UAE authorities) may authorize specific broker activities under defined conditions. Always verify through official regulator records.

dueDiligence.title: Due Diligence
dueDiligence.body: Clients should review what is actually verified and disclosed, not rely on marketing claims. Read risk warnings and understand jurisdictional limitations.
